_: Standard merge-first answers (driver/standard-answer.sh). Read only while release.mergeFirst is on; release.standardAnswers in harness.json replaces this file, false turns it off. Patterns are jq regexes, case-insensitive, over the step's question and its park reason. park is read first and always wins; then the classes in order, first match taken. A class with `kind` is taken first when the step's answer names that questionKind; a class with `beforePark` is read before the park list.

a.name: base red: wait
a.answer: Wait. A red the base branch has too is the base's to fix, never this change's: the ticket waits for the base (base-red), and nothing of the base is fixed here.

b.name: follow-up of an open PR: wait for the parent
b.answer: Wait. A follow-up of a pull request that has not merged waits for that pull request: the ticket is blocked on the parent and goes back to ready when it merges. Nothing is folded into the parent.

e.name: signed off: ship
e.answer: Ship as signed off. Under merge first nothing is re-captured or re-signed before the merge; the owner looks on UAT.

c.name: Minor or Major finding: defer
c.answer: Defer it as fix-after-merge and ship. Until the release only a Critical blocks; a Major or Minor finding is its own follow-up ticket (a Minor waits until after launch).

d.name: critic, evidence or pictures: ignore
d.answer: Ignore it and ship. Until the release the design critic, the evidence, the screenshots and the picture hold nothing; the owner looks on UAT.

f.name: a dependency not built yet: wait for it
f.answer: Wait. A ticket whose dependency has not merged waits for it: it is gated on the tickets it needs and goes back to ready when they have merged (scripts/unblock-waiting.sh). Nothing is built ahead of them.

g.name: base red, already proved: carry on
g.answer: Carry on. The same checks fail at the merge base with this change removed, so they are the base's (base-red): they are discounted here, the develop-red ticket owns them, and this change goes ahead. Nothing of the base is fixed in this branch.

h.name: already done on develop: close it
h.answer: Close it. The ticket's ask already holds on develop, done by a merged pull request or a commit on develop that the driver verified: the ticket is closed as completed with that evidence, and nothing is built.

i.name: UAT or production data: never read it
i.answer: No. A builder never reads UAT or production data: no Railway database, no SELECT, read-only or not. Measure on the local seed or the test fixtures instead, and say in the pull request that the number comes from there.

j.name: a passing change not committed: the driver commits it
j.answer: The driver committed the change in the worktree, so it is this step's commit now: carry on from it and answer as if you had committed it.
